messages:
zoe_csm: Quick alert — APAC onboarding webhooks started returning 429/5xx for many trial tenants between 02:14-02:35 UTC. Drafting a customer-facing status + remediation. Need quick review.

zoe_csm: ```
Subject: Notice: APAC onboarding delays (Mar 22)

Hello,

We experienced intermittent onboarding and webhook throttling issues for APAC customers today between 02:1402:35 UTC. Some trial and new accounts saw delayed or failed onboarding flows and partial index writes.

Short cause: an ingress rate-limiter misconfiguration combined with a brief retry spike caused webhook throttling for a subset of APAC regions.

What we did: we adjusted rate limits and restored normal traffic at 02:30 UTC, and restarted backfill workflows. Automated replays completed for most items; engineering will coordinate manual replays where needed.

Support: affected customers will receive two weeks of account credit. If you are in active renewal discussions, your AE will reach out to arrange an account-specific remediation (extensions, credits, or hands-on replays). If you onboarded through SSO/VPC and still see errors, reply here or open a ticket and well prioritise an engineering replay.

Status: https://status.redwood.ai

Thanks,
Zoe, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
```

mike_support: Tone okay. Suggest swapping "two weeks" -> "two-week" credit phrasing and adding support portal link.

kai_eng: RCA short: ingress rate-limiter config key rolled without the new capacity window; concurrent retry spike amplified throttles. Fix at 02:30 UTC. Backfills finished by 03:05 UTC; ~1.5% flagged for manual replay. Permanent change: add canary gating + larger default capacity for APAC ingress. ETA: 48h.

lina_ae: For renewals please exclude AE-managed accounts from automatic credit and Ill handle outreach. Ill take the two impacted renewal accounts I own.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260322-0214 created  severity P3  owners=eng-oncall,cs-ops.

zoe_csm: Final: Ill send this at 08:00 UTC and post to status. Lina, please flag your renewals in Gainsight so billing excludes them. Any last edits?

mike_support: Add support portal URL and brief note on how to request a replay.

zoe_csm: Added. Sending at 08:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
